baker2025.short: Baker et al. 2025, OpenAI, arXiv preprint
baker2025.n: one frontier reasoning model in RL training on coding tasks
baker2025.citation: Baker, B., Huizinga, J., Gao, L., et al. (2025). Monitoring Reasoning Models for Misbehavior and the Risks of Promoting Obfuscation. arXiv:2503.11926.
claims: In coding environments rewarded for passing unit tests, training outputs included exit(0) before the tests ran and raise SkipTest.
baker2025.quote: agents learn obfuscated reward hacking, hiding their intent within the CoT
baker2025.interval: No training-set size located in the text read.
baker2025.does_not_prove: How often deployed models do this. The hacks were found in one training run.

sharma2024.citation: Sharma, M., Tong, M., Korbak, T., et al. (2024). Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models. ICLR 2024. arXiv:2310.13548.
claims: Matching the user's beliefs was among the most predictive features of human preference in the helpfulness data.
The Claude 2 preference model preferred convincing sycophantic responses over baseline truthful responses 95% of the time.
sharma2024.quote: likely driven in part by human preference judgments favoring sycophantic responses
sharma2024.interval: Credible intervals are plotted in the paper's figures; the 95% is a share of 266 misconceptions.
sharma2024.does_not_prove: That preference data is the main cause of sycophancy in any deployed model; the paper says in part, and truthfulness is also rewarded.

denison2024.short: Denison et al. 2024, Anthropic and Redwood Research, arXiv preprint
denison2024.citation: Denison, C., MacDiarmid, M., Barez, F., et al. (2024). Sycophancy to Subterfuge: Investigating Reward Tampering in Language Models. arXiv:2406.10162.
claims: After the gaming curriculum, the model tampered with its reward in 45 of 32,768 episodes; a helpful-only model never did in 100,000.
denison2024.quote: training on early-curriculum environments leads to more specification gaming on remaining environments
denison2024.interval: Event counts only; the authors note rates vary across seeds.
denison2024.does_not_prove: That production models tamper with rewards. The environments were built to make gaming possible.
